header:
states.yaml — Key Personnel · state-by-state employment-law overlays a recruiter must check (sweep 8, written 2026-10-22)
One record per state and the District of Columbia. Nine overlays per record, each with its own status, cited text, sources,
primary_pending flag and the gate(s) it modifies. Schema: EXTENSIONS.md (states.yaml), extended in sweep 8.

status vocabulary — pay_transparency: posting | on-request | pending | local-only | none-found;
salary_history_ban: statewide | local-only | preempted | unresolved | none-found; noncompete: void | void-from-2027 |
income-threshold | category-limits | sector-limits | common-law; stay_or_pay: statewide | pending | sector-limits | none-found;
ai_hiring: statewide | pending | local-only | none-found; cannabis_testing: statewide | medical-only | not-checked | none-found;
ban_the_box: private | public-only | not-checked | none-found; credit_check: statewide | disclosure-only | local-only | none-found;
mini_warn: statewide | reported | none-found.

Provenance. The overlays rest on dated compilations read on 2026-10-22: Mercer's equal-pay roundup [207] and the posting-law
map [76] with the 2026 enactments [223] [224]; the DOL Women's Bureau map [208] (table unreadable); the Loio noncompete tracker
[209]; the stay-or-pay maps [211] [212]; the Brightmine AI chart [220]; the MPP cannabis page [219]; the NELP fair-chance guide
[216] with the 2026 vendor list [217]; the Verified First credit-check guide [218]; the mini-WARN alert and chart [213] [214].
Primaries read in this sweep: Washington ESHB 1155 [210] and ESB 6106 [215]; the Colorado SB 26-189 fiscal note [222]; the
California ADS regulations [40] and New York City's Local Law 144 audit [37] were read in sweep 1 and carry their overlays.
`primary_pending: true` means no primary source is among the overlay's sources; the statute is a todo (t-8001) and the app
shows the overlay as "compilation-sourced; verify". `none-found` means the state is absent from the named compilation as of
its date, not that the law has been checked. The federal-contractor gates apply in every state; the state cannabis protections
all except federal contracts, funding and clearance work, and several credit-check laws except clearance positions.
recheck: true on every record until the live-page pass.
